title: Hearty Gooey Vietnamese Pork Ca Kho To
description: A peppery and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring pork, wood-fired-baked to perfection, with anti-inflammatory properties.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, coconut sugar, black pepper, garlic, and ginger.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Smoke the pork in the wood-fired oven for 2 hours, using the wood chips for flavor.
After 2 hours, increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the pork hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs and steamed vegetables.
